purpose: Case detail and review visual concepts only; no application changes.
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Draw a polished legible 1536x1024 landscape desktop web application UI concept for Ombuddi, a secure recordkeeping tool for professional ombuds. Front-on software screen, no computer hardware or physical desk props. Continue an approved design language: warm light manila folder #EDDBB3 with understated folder tab, crisp white paper #FFFFFF on top with subtle shadow, charcoal readable text #273334, subdued plum actions #743D68, sage and pale lavender small code flags attached with a tiny translucent horizontal tape strip. White paper and manila stay light even against a DARK TEAL finely patterned surrounding page and dark teal slim existing-style site navigation. Header text 'ombuddi' at left and 'Cases' 'People' 'Reports' 'Account'. Thoughtful spacious layout, no loud gradients, no thick borders, no repeated boxed cards, no scrapbook decorations. Large editorial serif case title, readable sans-serif controls and body. Use fictional case 'Cedar / River / Lantern', small abstract landscape recognition thumbnail, status 'Active', quiet 'Created Sep 12 · Updated Oct 9'. Keep description clearly separate from selected entry Notes. Case codes use small sage '2E Communication' and lavender 'W1 Workplace' flags labelled IOA and Organization, not freeform tags. Referral summary 'Peer or colleague'. People shown as anonymous geometric avatars with label '2 linked people', no actual names, initials or invented identities. Protected notes remain hidden in drawings: 'Notes are locked' with a clear 'Unlock notes' action; description similarly 'Description locked' and 'Unlock'. No fake confidential case content, no revealing names. Do not imply folder appearance provides security. Entry detail example 'Oct 9, 2026', 'Video call', '45 min', 'Edit entry'. Other activity rows 'Oct 2 · Email · 15 min', 'Sep 24 · In person · 60 min'. Feature-preservation goals: Back to all cases, name/status/date/description, edit case details, IOA & organization code editing, referral editing, case people, dated activity list, add entry, selected entry metadata/notes/people and edit entry action. Current app uses an activity list selecting a detail panel. New tabs or cross-case navigation are proposed affordances. Avoid adding export, AI summaries, attachments, tasks, chat or autosave. Every interface should be believable and easy to build. Add a narrow caption band OUTSIDE the app screen at bottom with numbered concept title and short explanation. Render all text correctly. CONCEPT 01: THE OPEN FOLDER. Show a single open manila folder filling the central page with a modest tab at top right labelled 'Active case'. A white full-width cover-sheet strip along top inside folder contains the scene thumbnail, large 'Cedar / River / Lantern' title, Active status, dates, and 'Edit case' quiet action. Next line 'Description locked' with Unlock, plus small referral summary and '2 linked people' anonymous avatars. Under cover-sheet strip: a narrow left WHITE ACTIVITY INDEX column about 260px wide, then a generous central WHITE ENTRY SHEET about 640px wide, and a visible 190px MANILA right margin with the two taped code flags stacked under distinct IOA CODES and ORGANIZATION CODES labels plus '+ Add code' for each. Left index heading 'Activity' with '3 entries'; three plain dated rows with whitespace and hairline dividers, Oct 9 selected with a plum bookmark-shaped edge and pale sage fill, not boxed cards. Central sheet heading 'Oct 9, 2026' with small 'Entry details' overline, Edit entry link top right, single metadata line 'Video call · 45 min', large airy Notes region showing tasteful small lock icon 'Notes are locked' and 'Unlock notes' text button, bottom 'People in this entry' with one anonymous geometric avatar. A slim plum 'Add entry' button sits at the folder's top action area. Keep layout whole and uncropped. This is closest to current functional layout but visually a physical case file with one focused paper page. Caption '01 / The open folder' and 'Case context above. Activity index beside the entry you are reading.'

CONCEPT 02: THE TABBED CASE FILE. A different information architecture, not a variant of first layout. One wide manila folder in dark teal patterned workspace with a small Back to all cases link above it. Folder top has three large horizontal physical index tabs rising from top edge: 'Overview', 'Activity (3)' selected and subtly lighter, 'People (2)'. Tabs must look like real clickable navigation and say what they reveal. In top manila band inside the folder, show small recognition scene and 'Cedar / River / Lantern' with Active and quiet dates, right plum 'Add entry'. Under this, ONE expansive white paper page, no separate summary card and no right metadata rail. On the active Activity paper page, left narrow margin contains a minimal vertical timeline 'Oct 9' selected, 'Oct 2', 'Sep 24' with small dots and hairline, central wide area heading 'Oct 9, 2026' with Edit entry at right, 'Video call · 45 min', Notes locked and Unlock notes, and anonymous people markers lower down. At bottom or outer right folder edge have two small labeled tape flags 'IOA · 2E Communication' and 'Org · W1 Workplace' always visible, plus 'Edit codes' quiet link. Since Overview is inactive do NOT show all its inputs on activity page; add small diagrammatic annotation below app inside caption band 'Overview holds description, status and referrals; Activity opens one entry; People shows linked records.' The point is less competing context while reviewing, with preserved access through sections. Main caption '02 / The tabbed case file'. Keep professional flat restrained tactile UI, clean generous paper, no simulated page turning or curled paper.

CONCEPT 03: THE REVIEW DESK. A broader cross-case review layout spanning the full app: narrow LEFT navigation column about 300px on dark teal page holding compact MINI MANILA FOLDER rows, RIGHT large open folder about 1050px with white paper interior. Top left heading 'Cases', small search 'Find a case…' and simple status filters 'Active' selected 'Monitoring' 'Closed'. Three compact mini folders aligned vertically with tiny white paper inset containing name and updated date, tiny scene thumbnail and readable status; labels 'Cedar / River / Lantern' selected with plum edge, 'Willow / Stone / Harbor', 'Birch / Meadow / Finch'. Keep these compact, unoverlapped, scannable—do not create a decorative shelf or giant folder grid. Left footer a quiet 'Log general activity' link separate from real case folders. Right open folder top tab 'Cedar / River / Lantern', white paper header displays same case title, recognition thumbnail and Active badge, dates and Edit case. Below a compact description locked/Unlock line and referral summary with Edit; tiny '2 linked people' markers. Right folder edge contains small tape flags 'IOA · 2E Communication' and 'Org · W1 Workplace'. On main paper, heading 'Activity' and plum 'Add entry', three compact horizontal date selectors 'Oct 9' active 'Oct 2' 'Sep 24', then selected detail 'Oct 9, 2026', 'Video call · 45 min', Edit entry, generous Notes locked/Unlock notes area and people-in-entry markers. Preserve clear distinction between left CASE selection and inner ENTRY selection. This is for reviewing several cases without returning to a separate listing screen. New search and status tabs are proposed. Main caption '03 / The review desk' and subtitle 'Move between cases while keeping the selected folder open.'
reviewDeskRefinement:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit this existing Ombuddi '03 / The review desk' UI concept with two precise corrections. Preserve the overall image, dark teal site navigation and patterned background, all case names and anonymous people icons, white paper on manila folder, colored tape flags, typography and composition.
1. In the LEFT Cases sidebar, replace the current three status filter buttons with four smaller compact filter buttons on a single row: 'All' selected in plum, then 'Active', 'Monitoring', 'Closed' unselected. This is necessary because the three visible sample cases span all statuses.
2. In the main white paper below Activity heading, REMOVE the redundant three date selector buttons 'Oct 9', 'Oct 2', 'Sep 24'. Use just the existing chronological activity list below: Oct 9 expanded, Oct 2 and Sep 24 collapsed. Shift the entry content up modestly into the freed space and increase white breathing room. Make entry row boundaries very subtle hairlines rather than heavy boxed cards. Keep Add entry, Edit entry, date/method/duration, Notes are locked, Unlock notes, people-in-entry icons. Keep caption exactly '03 / The review desk' and 'Move between cases while keeping the selected folder open.' No new features, no other changes.
